verses.original: Ἔλεγεν δὲ παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς πρὸς τὸ δεῖν πάντοτε προσεύχεσθαι αὐτοὺς καὶ μὴ ἐνκακεῖν
verses.transliteration: Elegen de parabolēn autois pros to dein pantote proseuchesthai autous kai mē enkakein
verses.literal: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart
verses.literalPt: E CONTOU-LHES também uma parábola sobre o dever de orar sempre, e nunca desfalecer,

verses.original: λέγων Κριτής τις ἦν ἔν τινι πόλει τὸν Θεὸν μὴ φοβούμενος καὶ ἄνθρωπον μὴ ἐντρεπόμενος
verses.transliteration: legōn Kritēs tis ēn en tini polei ton Theon mē phoboumenos kai anthrōpon mē entrepomenos
verses.literal: In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Havia numa cidade um certo juiz, que nem a Deus temia, nem respeitava o homem.

verses.original: χήρα δὲ ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσα Ἐκδίκησόν με ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀντιδίκου μου
verses.transliteration: chēra de ēn en tē polei ekeinē kai ērcheto pros auton legousa Ekdikēson me apo tou antidikou mou
verses.literal: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing . . . to him Give me justice . . . against my adversary
verses.literalPt: Havia também, naquela mesma cidade, uma certa viúva, que ia ter com ele, dizendo: Faze-me justiça contra o meu adversário.

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἐπὶ χρόνον μετὰ ταῦτα δὲ εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ Εἰ καὶ τὸν Θεὸν οὐ φοβοῦμαι οὐδὲ ἄνθρωπον ἐντρέπομαι
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk ēthelen epi chronon meta tauta de eipen en heautō Ei kai ton Theon ou phoboumai oude anthrōpon entrepomai
verses.literal: For a while he refused but later he said to himself Though . . . I neither fear God nor respect men
verses.literalPt: E por algum tempo não quis atendê-la; mas depois disse consigo: Ainda que não temo a Deus, nem respeito os homens,

verses.original: διά γε τὸ παρέχειν μοι κόπον τὴν χήραν ταύτην ἐκδικήσω αὐτήν ἵνα μὴ εἰς τέλος ἐρχομένη ὑπωπιάζῃ με
verses.transliteration: dia ge to parechein moi kopon tēn chēran tautēn ekdikēsō autēn hina mē eis telos erchomenē hypōpiazē me
verses.literal: yet because this widow keeps pestering me . . . . . . I will give her justice . . . Otherwise . . . she will wear me out . . . with her perpetual requests . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todavia, como esta viúva me molesta, hei de fazer-lhe justiça, para que enfim não volte, e me importune muito.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Κύριος Ἀκούσατε τί ὁ κριτὴς τῆς ἀδικίας λέγει
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Kyrios Akousate ti ho kritēs tēs adikias legei
verses.literal: And the Lord said Listen to the words of the unjust judge
verses.literalPt: E disse o Senhor: Ouvi o que diz o injusto juiz.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς οὐ μὴ ποιήσῃ τὴν ἐκδίκησιν τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν βοώντων αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός καὶ μακροθυμεῖ ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: ho de Theos ou mē poiēsē tēn ekdikēsin tōn eklektōn autou tōn boōntōn autō hēmeras kai nyktos kai makrothymei ep’ autois
verses.literal: Will not . . . God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night Will He delay in helping . . . them
verses.literalPt: E Deus não fará justiça aos seus escolhidos, que clamam a ele de dia e de noite, ainda que tardio para com eles?

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ποιήσει τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτῶν ἐν τάχει πλὴν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐλθὼν ἆρα εὑρήσει τὴν πίστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: legō hymin hoti poiēsei tēn ekdikēsin autōn en tachei plēn ho Huios tou anthrōpou elthōn ara heurēsei tēn pistin epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: I tell you He will promptly carry out . . . . . . justice on their behalf Nevertheless when the Son of Man comes will He find - faith on earth
verses.literalPt: Digo-vos que depressa lhes fará justiça. Quando porém vier o Filho do homem, porventura achará fé na terra?

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ πρός τινας τοὺς πεποιθότας ἐφ’ ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι εἰσὶν δίκαιοι καὶ ἐξουθενοῦντας τοὺς λοιποὺς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: Eipen de kai pros tinas tous pepoithotas eph’ heautois hoti eisin dikaioi kai exouthenountas tous loipous tēn parabolēn tautēn
verses.literal: To some who trusted in their own . . . . . . righteousness and viewed others with contempt He also told this parable
verses.literalPt: E disse também esta parábola a uns que confiavam em si mesmos, crendo que eram justos, e desprezavam os outros:

verses.original: Ἄνθρωποι δύο ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσεύξασθαι ὁ εἷς Φαρισαῖος καὶ ὁ ἕτερος τελώνης
verses.transliteration: Anthrōpoi dyo anebēsan eis to hieron proseuxasthai ho heis Pharisaios kai ho heteros telōnēs
verses.literal: Two men went up to the temple to pray One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector
verses.literalPt: Dois homens subiram ao templo, para orar; um, fariseu, e o outro, publicano.

verses.original: ὁ Φαρισαῖος σταθεὶς ταῦτα πρὸς ἑαυτὸν προσηύχετο Ὁ Θεός εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ ὥσπερ οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἅρπαγες ἄδικοι μοιχοί ἢ καὶ ὡς οὗτος ὁ τελώνης
verses.transliteration: ho Pharisaios statheis tauta pros heauton prosēucheto HO Theos eucharistō soi hoti ouk eimi hōsper hoi loipoi tōn anthrōpōn harpages adikoi moichoi ē kai hōs houtos ho telōnēs
verses.literal: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed God I thank You that I am not like other men swindlers evildoers adulterers or even like this tax collector
verses.literalPt: O fariseu, estando em pé, orava consigo desta maneira: Ó Deus, graças te dou porque não sou como os demais homens, roubadores, injustos e adúlteros; nem ainda como este publicano.

verses.original: νηστεύω δὶς τοῦ σαββάτου ἀποδεκατῶ πάντα ὅσα κτῶμαι
verses.transliteration: nēsteuō dis tou sabbatou apodekatō panta hosa ktōmai
verses.literal: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that . . . I acquire
verses.literalPt: Jejuo duas vezes na semana, e dou os dízimos de tudo quanto possuo.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ τελώνης μακρόθεν ἑστὼς οὐκ ἤθελεν οὐδὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπᾶραι εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν ἀλλ’ ἔτυπτεν τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ λέγων Ὁ Θεός ἱλάσθητί μοι τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho de telōnēs makrothen hestōs ouk ēthelen oude tous ophthalmous eparai eis ton ouranon all’ etypten to stēthos autou legōn HO Theos hilasthēti moi tō hamartōlō
verses.literal: But the tax collector stood at a distance unwilling even . . . to lift up his eyes to heaven Instead he beat his breast and said God have mercy on me a sinner
verses.literalPt: O publicano, porém, estando em pé, de longe, nem ainda queria levantar os olhos ao céu, mas batia no peito, dizendo: Ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim, pecador!

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν κατέβη οὗτος δεδικαιωμένος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ παρ’ ἐκεῖνον ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται ὁ δὲ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: legō hymin katebē houtos dedikaiōmenos eis ton oikon autou par’ ekeinon hoti pas ho hypsōn heauton tapeinōthēsetai ho de tapeinōn heauton hypsōthēsetai
verses.literal: I tell you this man rather than the Pharisee went home . . . . . . . . . . . . justified For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled but the one who humbles himself will be exalted
verses.literalPt: Digo-vos que este desceu justificado para sua casa, e não aquele; porque qualquer que a si mesmo se exalta será humilhado, e qualquer que a si mesmo se humilha será exaltado.

verses.original: Προσέφερον δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ τὰ βρέφη ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅπτηται ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Prosepheron de autō kai ta brephē hina autōn haptētai idontes de hoi mathētai epetimōn autois
verses.literal: Now people were even bringing . . . their babies to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them And when the disciples saw this they rebuked those who brought them
verses.literalPt: E traziam-lhe também meninos, para que ele lhes tocasse; e os discípulos, vendo isto, repreendiam-nos.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσεκαλέσατο αὐτὰ λέγων Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous prosekalesato auta legōn Aphete ta paidia erchesthai pros me kai mē kōlyete auta tōn gar toioutōn estin hē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: But Jesus called the children to Him . . . and said Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus, chamando-os para si, disse: Deixai vir a mim os meninos, e não os impeçais, porque dos tais é o reino de Deus.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hos an mē dexētai tēn basileian tou Theou hōs paidion ou mē eiselthē eis autēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter . . . it
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que, qualquer que não receber o reino de Deus como menino, não entrará nele.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησέν τις αὐτὸν ἄρχων λέγων Διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtēsen tis auton archōn legōn Didaskale agathe ti poiēsas zōēn aiōnion klēronomēsō
verses.literal: Then a certain ruler asked Him Good Teacher what must I do to inherit eternal life
verses.literalPt: E perguntou-lhe um certo príncipe, dizendo: Bom Mestre, que hei de fazer para herdar a vida eterna?

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autō ho Iēsous Ti me legeis agathon oudeis agathos ei mē heis ho Theos
verses.literal: Why do you call Me good - Jesus replied No one is good except . . . God alone
verses.literalPt: Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém há bom, senão um, que é Deus.

verses.original: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς Μὴ φονεύσῃς Μὴ κλέψῃς Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα
verses.transliteration: tas entolas oidas Mē moicheusēs Mē phoneusēs Mē klepsēs Mē pseudomartyrēsēs Tima ton patera sou kai tēn mētera
verses.literal: You know the commandments Do not commit adultery do not murder do not steal do not bear false witness honor your father and mother
verses.literalPt: Sabes os mandamentos: Não adulterarás, não matarás, não furtarás, não dirás falso testemunho, honra a teu pai e a tua mãe.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα ἐκ νεότητος μου
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Tauta panta ephylaxa ek neotētos mou
verses.literal: All these I have kept from my youth - he said
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Todas essas coisas tenho observado desde a minha mocidade.

verses.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἔτι ἕν σοι λείπει πάντα ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ διάδος πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: Akousas de ho Iēsous eipen autō Eti hen soi leipei panta hosa echeis pōlēson kai diados ptōchois kai hexeis thēsauron en tois ouranois kai deuro akolouthei moi
verses.literal: On hearing this Jesus told him You still lack one thing Sell everything . . . you own and give to the poor and you will have treasure in heaven Then come follow Me
verses.literalPt: E quando Jesus ouviu isto, disse-lhe: Ainda te falta uma coisa; vende tudo quanto tens, reparte-o pelos pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; vem, e segue-me.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀκούσας ταῦτα περίλυπος ἐγενήθη ἦν γὰρ πλούσιος σφόδρα
verses.transliteration: Ho de akousas tauta perilypos egenēthē ēn gar plousios sphodra
verses.literal: But when the ruler heard this he became very sad because he was extremely wealthy
verses.literalPt: Mas, ouvindo ele isto, ficou muito triste, porque era muito rico.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς περίλυπον γενόμενον εἶπεν Πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ χρήματα ἔχοντες εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσπορεύονται
verses.transliteration: Idōn de auton ho Iēsous perilypon genomenon eipen Pōs dyskolōs hoi ta chrēmata echontes eis tēn basileian tou Theou eisporeuontai
verses.literal: Seeing the man’s sadness Jesus said How hard it is for the rich to enter . . . the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: E, vendo Jesus que ele ficara muito triste, disse: Quão dificilmente entrarão no reino de Deus os que têm riquezas!

verses.original: εὐκοπώτερον γάρ ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρήματος βελόνης εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: eukopōteron gar estin kamēlon dia trēmatos belonēs eiselthein ē plousion eis tēn basileian tou Theou eiselthein
verses.literal: Indeed it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter . . . the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: Porque é mais fácil entrar um camelo pelo fundo de uma agulha do que entrar um rico no reino de Deus.

verses.original: Εἶπαν δὲ οἱ ἀκούσαντες Καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Eipan de hoi akousantes Kai tis dynatai sōthēnai
verses.literal: Those who heard this asked Who then can be saved
verses.literalPt: E os que ouviram isto disseram: Logo quem pode salvar-se?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Τὰ ἀδύνατα παρὰ ἀνθρώποις δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Ta adynata para anthrōpois dynata para tō Theō estin
verses.literal: But Jesus said What is impossible with man is possible with God
verses.literalPt: Mas ele respondeu: As coisas que são impossíveis aos homens são possíveis a Deus.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφέντες τὰ ἴδια ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Petros Idou hēmeis aphentes ta idia ēkolouthēsamen soi
verses.literal: Look - said Peter we have left all we had to follow You
verses.literalPt: E disse Pedro: Eis que nós deixamos tudo e te seguimos.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ γονεῖς ἢ τέκνα ἕνεκεν τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Amēn legō hymin hoti oudeis estin hos aphēken oikian ē gynaika ē adelphous ē goneis ē tekna heneken tēs basileias tou Theou
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - Jesus replied - no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Na verdade vos digo que ninguém há, que tenha deixado casa, ou pais, ou irmãos, ou mulher, ou filhos, pelo reino de Deus,

verses.original: ὃς οὐχὶ μὴ ἀπολάβῃ πολλαπλασίονα ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: hos ouchi mē apolabē pollaplasiona en tō kairō toutō kai en tō aiōni tō erchomenō zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: will fail to receive many times more in this age and in the age to come eternal life
verses.literalPt: Que não haja de receber muito mais neste mundo, e na idade vindoura a vida eterna.

verses.original: Παραλαβὼν δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ καὶ τελεσθήσεται πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα διὰ τῶν προφητῶν τῷ Υἱῷ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: Paralabōn de tous dōdeka eipen pros autous Idou anabainomen eis Ierousalēm kai telesthēsetai panta ta gegrammena dia tōn prophētōn tō Huiō tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: Then Jesus took the Twelve aside and said to them Look we are going up to Jerusalem and everything the prophets have written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled
verses.literalPt: E, tomando consigo os doze, disse-lhes: Eis que subimos a Jerusalém, e se cumprirá no Filho do homem tudo o que pelos profetas foi escrito;

verses.original: παραδοθήσεται γὰρ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐμπαιχθήσεται καὶ ὑβρισθήσεται καὶ ἐμπτυσθήσεται
verses.transliteration: paradothēsetai gar tois ethnesin kai empaichthēsetai kai hybristhēsetai kai emptysthēsetai
verses.literal: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon
verses.literalPt: Pois há de ser entregue aos gentios, e escarnecido, injuriado e cuspido;

verses.original: καὶ μαστιγώσαντες ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἀναστήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai mastigōsantes apoktenousin auton kai tē hēmera tē tritē anastēsetai
verses.literal: They will flog Him and kill Him and on the third day He will rise again
verses.literalPt: E, havendo-o açoitado, o matarão; e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐδὲν τούτων συνῆκαν καὶ ἦν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο κεκρυμμένον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον τὰ λεγόμενα
verses.transliteration: Kai autoi ouden toutōn synēkan kai ēn to rhēma touto kekrymmenon ap’ autōn kai ouk eginōskon ta legomena
verses.literal: But the disciples did not understand any . . . of these things - The meaning was hidden from them and they did not comprehend what He was saying
verses.literalPt: E eles nada disto entendiam, e esta palavra lhes era encoberta, não percebendo o que se lhes dizia.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰεριχὼ τυφλός τις ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἐπαιτῶν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō engizein auton eis Ierichō typhlos tis ekathēto para tēn hodon epaitōn
verses.literal: As . . . . . . Jesus drew near to Jericho a blind man was sitting beside the road begging
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que chegando ele perto de Jericó, estava um cego assentado junto do caminho, mendigando.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὄχλου διαπορευομένου ἐπυνθάνετο τί εἴη τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: akousas de ochlou diaporeuomenou epynthaneto ti eiē touto
verses.literal: When he heard the crowd going by he asked what was happening
verses.literalPt: E, ouvindo passar a multidão, perguntou que era aquilo.

verses.original: Ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος παρέρχεται
verses.transliteration: Apēngeilan de autō hoti Iēsous ho Nazōraios parerchetai
verses.literal: Jesus of Nazareth is passing by they told him
verses.literalPt: E disseram-lhe que Jesus Nazareno passava.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐβόησεν λέγων Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ Δαυίδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: Kai eboēsen legōn Iēsou huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: So he called out Jesus Son of David have mercy on me
verses.literalPt: Então clamou, dizendo: Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ προάγοντες ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ ἵνα σιγήσῃ αὐτὸς δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν Υἱὲ Δαυίδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi proagontes epetimōn autō hina sigēsē autos de pollō mallon ekrazen Huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: Those who led the way admonished him - to be silent but he cried out all the louder Son of David have mercy on me
verses.literalPt: E os que iam passando repreendiam-no para que se calasse; mas ele clamava ainda mais: Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim!

verses.original: Σταθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ἀχθῆναι πρὸς αὐτόν ἐγγίσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Statheis de ho Iēsous ekeleusen auton achthēnai pros auton engisantos de autou epērōtēsen auton
verses.literal: Jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to Him When he had come near Jesus asked him
verses.literalPt: Então Jesus, parando, mandou que lho trouxessem; e, chegando ele, perguntou-lhe,

verses.original: Τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Κύριε ἵνα ἀναβλέψω
verses.transliteration: Ti soi theleis poiēsō Ho de eipen Kyrie hina anablepsō
verses.literal: What do you want Me to do for you Lord - he said let me see again
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Que queres que te faça? E ele disse: Senhor, que eu veja.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀνάβλεψον ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous eipen autō Anablepson hē pistis sou sesōken se
verses.literal: Receive your sight - Jesus replied Your faith has healed you
verses.literalPt: E Jesus lhe disse: Vê; a tua fé te salvou.

verses.original: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνέβλεψεν καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ δοξάζων τὸν Θεόν καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἰδὼν ἔδωκεν αἶνον τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: kai parachrēma aneblepsen kai ēkolouthei autō doxazōn ton Theon kai pas ho laos idōn edōken ainon tō Theō
verses.literal: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus glorifying God And all the people when they saw it gave praise to God
verses.literalPt: E logo viu, e seguia-o, glorificando a Deus. E todo o povo, vendo isto, dava louvores a Deus.
